items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: And then I met Ray and Oscar and all those, we did gigs together.

ctx.x: And then I met Ray and Oscar and all those, we did gigs together. Well anyway I began to investigate Ray Brown, like when I went on leave I heard some of his things coming out of a jukebox in Savannah, the trio playing. And I said that’s Oscar, huh? And then I began to investigate Charlie Parker and I used to listen to that because guys would bring
their music in and I’d listen and listen and listen. I don’t know if I was really learning anything but it was part of my consciousness now.
